name: Cerenovus
ability: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
designRole: Forces a player to be mad about a selected good character or risk execution.
explanation: Forces a player to be mad about a selected good character or risk execution.

nightInstructions.firstNight: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
nightInstructions.otherNights: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.

jinxes.reason: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.
